scripts.build: npm run build:mv2 && npm run build:mv3

chromium.mv2: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "chromium" && "$2" != "3" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=2 BROWSER=chromium npm run test:fragments-local; fi
chromium.mv3: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "chromium" && "$2" != "2" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=3 BROWSER=chromium npm run test:fragments-local; fi

firefox.mv2: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "firefox" && "$2" != "3" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=2 BROWSER=firefox npm run test:fragments-local; fi
firefox.mv3: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "firefox" && "$2" == "3" ]]; then echo "Firefox tests are not supported with extension in Manifest v3"; exit 1; fi

edge.mv2: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "edge" && "$2" != "3" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=2 BROWSER=edge npm run test:fragments-local; fi
edge.mv3: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "edge" && "$2" == "3" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=3 BROWSER=edge npm run test:fragments-local; fi

chrome.mv3: if [[ -z "$1" || "$1" == "chrome" && "$2" != "2" ]]; then MANIFEST_VERSION=3 BROWSER=chrome npm run test:fragments-local; fi
